reviews.reason: The supplied scans support this complete cross-page unit: printed p72 ends with ወእቤ፡ ሠናይዝ፡; p74 continues with ዕፀ፡ ወ*ከመ፡ [ሠናይ፡ ወ]ፍሡሕ፡ ርእየቱ። before verse marker 6. The asterisk, brackets, and terminal wording are preserved. English [beautiful and] corresponds to the bracketed words. The footnote accurately reports p74 note 2, “Omit with G, q,” without claiming unanimous transmission or identifying a species. Acceptance is limited to 32:5.
